title: Future Ready: Salary & Taxes
learningGoals: Calculate take-home pay after taxes and PF
Identify common Indian tax components (TDS, Professional Tax)

teachingScript.teacherLine: When you get your first job, you'll receive a Salary Slip. It's not just one number — it has many parts! Let's decode it.

data.title: The Salary Breakdown
points: Gross Salary: Total payout promised by the company.
Deductions: Taxes, Provident Fund (PF), and Insurance.
Net Salary: The actual cash that hits your bank account!

teachingScript.teacherLine: In India, the government takes a small portion of your high salary to build roads, schools, and hospitals. This is called Income Tax.
Time to act like a pro. Here is a realistic Indian salary slip for an employee earning ₹75,000 per month. Click on each section to decode the 'Pro Secrets' behind Basic Pay, HRA, and TDS!

questionPool.questionText: If your Gross Salary is ₹50,000 and the total deductions are ₹5,000, what is your Net Salary?
